nodes.label: WhatsApp Backend Migration: Baileys → evolution-go
nodes.rationale: Old self-hosted Baileys-based Evolution API instance became unreliable (stuck-PENDING messages, Signal pre-key sync errors, WebSocket timeouts) even after targeted Redis cache fixes; deleted and replaced with evolution-go (Go + whatsmeow) per explicit user decision after being warned of API-compatibility, licensing, and cost risk.

nodes.label: Interactive WhatsApp Order-Confirmation Buttons
nodes.rationale: Added native WhatsApp reply-buttons (تأكيد/إلغاء) to the order-approved notification via evolution-go's /send/button endpoint, with a parallel inbound ButtonClick n8n branch kept independent from the existing typed-reply fallback flow.

nodes.label: Testimonial CRUD Refactor
nodes.rationale: Rewrote testimonial admin CRUD to match the existing category pattern (list+form components, create/edit pages, ApiEnvelope responses, i18n) for consistency across admin CRUD surfaces.

nodes.label: Recharts Admin Dashboard Upgrade
nodes.rationale: Installed Recharts v3 and rebuilt dashboard charts (AreaChart, DonutChart, animated counters, sparklines) to be RTL- and dark-mode-aware, replacing hand-rolled SVG charts.

nodes.label: 012 Admin CRM + WhatsApp Spec
nodes.rationale: Full CRM+WhatsApp messaging spec (spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md) produced with the CTO agent for customer management + Evolution API integration, ready for phased @backend/@frontend/@n8n implementation.

nodes.label: Lookbook Hero + Navbar Redesign (Horizontal Filmstrip)
nodes.rationale: Redesigned the store homepage hero to a scroll-driven horizontal filmstrip with a transparent hero-scoped navbar, matching a McLaren-headphones reference; fixed two Web Animations API keyframe-offset gotchas (monotonic offsets, implicit 0/1 keyframes causing ghost layers).

nodes.label: B2C Storefront Expansion Plan + Implementation
nodes.rationale: Planned and began a full B2C storefront (4 categories, many products, cart/checkout) alongside the existing single-product funnel per the user's 'Dynamic Lookbook' homepage brief; landed uncommitted with Phase 4/5 runtime verification cut short.

nodes.label: Spec-kit-Planned Admin Overhaul (categories UX, analytics, design system, RTL toggle)
nodes.rationale: Initialized GitHub Spec Kit in-repo (.specify/, constitution v1.1.0, specs/001-006) and used it to plan/implement a categories admin fix, dashboard analytics widgets, and a 3-phase admin visual overhaul (theming, bento redesign, EN/AR+RTL toggle).
nodes.norm_label: spec-kit-planned admin overhaul (categories ux, analytics, design system, rtl toggle)

nodes.label: Per-Project Session-Awareness Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Added a per-project AI change-log plus a SessionStart hook (session-context.sh) that auto-loads the 3 latest CHANGELOG entries into every new session, so future sessions inherit prior-change context.

nodes.label: Principle I: Layered Architecture (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
nodes.rationale: Every domain MUST flow Repository -> Service -> API route -> RTK Query -> Hooks -> Components; client components must not import supabase.ts, repositories, or services since those run server-side only and would crash the client bundle or leak service-role credentials.

nodes.label: Principle II: TypeScript Strict, Always Green
nodes.rationale: npx tsc --noEmit MUST pass before any change is done, npm run build MUST succeed before deployment-ready; no `any` escape hatches to silence errors.
nodes.norm_label: principle ii: typescript strict, always green

nodes.label: Principle III: RTL/i18n Correctness
nodes.rationale: Any surface that can render dir="rtl" must use logical CSS properties instead of physical ones, with zero exceptions; direction is now a runtime toggle so both LTR/RTL states must work, not just the one tested.

nodes.label: Principle IV: No Business Logic in Components
nodes.rationale: Pages and components are declarative rendering only; data fetching, validation, derived state, and formatting rules live in hooks (client) or services (server).
nodes.norm_label: principle iv: no business logic in components

nodes.label: Principle V: Reuse Existing Primitives Over New Dependencies
nodes.rationale: UI work must reuse existing chart primitives and CRUD form/list/modal patterns instead of introducing new charting/UI libraries, unless the existing primitive genuinely cannot express the requirement.
nodes.norm_label: principle v: reuse existing primitives over new dependencies

nodes.label: Principle VI: Preserve State Machine & Factory Contracts
nodes.rationale: orderStateMachine.ts and shipping.factory.ts are the single source of truth for order-status transitions and shipping-provider selection; features must never re-implement status logic inline or hardcode a shipping provider branch.
nodes.norm_label: principle vi: preserve state machine & factory contracts

nodes.label: Full SDD Cycle Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs specify -> plan -> tasks -> implement in sequence with review gates (approve/reject) between specify/plan and plan/tasks, aborting on rejection.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern (Data Access)
nodes.rationale: Every domain has a *.repository.ts that is the only file touching Supabase; services call repositories, never Supabase directly, keeping database concerns isolated and testable.

nodes.label: Factory Pattern (Shipping)
nodes.rationale: All shipping providers implement IShippingProvider (createDelivery, trackDelivery, cancelDelivery, mapStatus) and are registered in shipping.factory.ts, enabling pluggable Bosta/ABS/Mylerz providers.

nodes.label: State Machine Pattern (Orders)
nodes.rationale: orderStateMachine.ts maps each OrderStatus to valid transitions and available actions; status flow is pending -> approved -> shipped -> delivered, with cancelled/returned branches.

nodes.label: RTK Query + Tag Invalidation (Client State)
nodes.rationale: Each domain has an RTK Query API slice using providesTags/invalidatesTags for automatic cache management; all API slices use baseQueryWithAuth which injects the Bearer token from Redux state.

nodes.label: WhatsApp CRM Messaging via n8n
nodes.rationale: The backend never calls Evolution API directly; all WhatsApp sends go through n8n (whatsapp.service.ts -> n8n webhook -> Evolution API plugin), keeping outbound/inbound/notification flows decoupled from the plugin implementation.

nodes.label: Admin Authentication Flow
nodes.rationale: Admin logs in via Supabase Auth, receives a JWT stored in Redux+localStorage; verifyAdmin() checks JWT validity AND membership in the admins Supabase table for every protected API route.

nodes.label: Dynamic Product Landing Pages
nodes.rationale: Each product's unique slug generates a landing page at /{slug}; the [slug]/page.tsx Server Component fetches by slug, 404s if missing/inactive, and renders the checkout funnel with dynamic SEO metadata.

nodes.label: Service ↔ Repository Separation
nodes.rationale: Repositories run server-only and do raw Supabase queries with no business logic; services run server-only and orchestrate business logic by calling repositories — never import a Repository or Service in a client component.

nodes.label: Service Pattern (Business Orchestration)
nodes.rationale: Business orchestration lives in *.service.ts files, one of the five mandatory design patterns (with Repository, Factory, State Machine, RTK Query) that CLAUDE.md instructs must be followed.

nodes.label: "Unit Tests for English" Checklist Concept
nodes.rationale: Checklists validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of requirements writing itself (completeness/clarity/consistency/measurability/coverage) rather than verifying implementation behavior — treating the spec as code and the checklist as its unit-test suite.

nodes.label: Append-Only Convergence Constraint
nodes.rationale: speckit-converge's only permitted write is appending a new '## Phase N: Convergence' section to tasks.md; it must never rewrite spec.md/plan.md or modify/renumber/delete existing tasks or application code, leaving tasks.md byte-for-byte unchanged when nothing is missing.

nodes.label: Spec-kit Extension Hooks Mechanism (.specify/extensions.yml)
nodes.rationale: Each speckit command checks .specify/extensions.yml for before_/after_<command> hook entries, skipping disabled or malformed hooks, and must actually invoke (not just print) any mandatory hook before proceeding.

nodes.label: Verified-Buyer Review Token
nodes.rationale: An HMAC-signed capability token (customerId, productId, orderId, exp) makes the web review link 'verified' without requiring a customer login; reuses the social.service.ts HMAC signing style.

nodes.label: Insert-only review submission rule
nodes.rationale: submitReview must INSERT-ONLY a pending review and never upsert/update an existing row, so a resubmit cannot downgrade an already-approved/rejected review back to pending or overwrite it.

nodes.label: Coupon invalid-at-submit fail-loud rule
nodes.rationale: If a coupon becomes invalid between preview and final order submission (e.g. hits usage_limit), the order creation must fail loud with a specific error rather than silently charging full price.

nodes.label: OrderDetailsDrawer discount reconciliation
nodes.rationale: OrderDetailsDrawer already derives a discount from compare_at_price; once explicit discount_amount/coupon_code exist, the two must be reconciled into one coherent discount line, preferring the explicit coupon line, to avoid double-counting.

nodes.label: Server-side order state machine enforcement
nodes.rationale: changeOrderStatus and the shipping webhook currently call updateOrderStatus with any target, allowing illegal jumps (e.g. pending->delivered); a canTransition() map becomes the single source of truth instead of only gating which buttons render.

nodes.label: Idempotent shipping-webhook transition guard
nodes.rationale: Providers (incl. the test simulator) send duplicate/out-of-order events; a disallowed transition on the webhook must log and return {success:true} as a no-op instead of a 4xx, so providers don't retry-storm.

nodes.label: confirmed->cancelled transition intentionally disallowed
nodes.rationale: A confirmed order already has a created shipment and decremented stock; cancelOrder only restores stock for approved and never calls cancelDelivery, so allowing cancel here would leak a live shipment and mis-count inventory.

nodes.label: Phone-keyed review token design decision
nodes.rationale: customers are unique by phone in this system; the WhatsApp/order flows already key off phone. Tying the review token to phone makes the review link portable across customer-record churn and aligns reviews with the same identity used across the funnel.

nodes.label: SOCIAL_MOCK_MODE demo-without-credentials mode
nodes.rationale: No developer apps are registered yet, so the full connect UX is built against env-var placeholders plus a mock connector so it works end-to-end with zero real credentials; real endpoints are coded but only used once creds are present.

nodes.label: Same-tab redirect UX (no popup/postMessage)
nodes.rationale: A same-tab top-level redirect lets the SameSite=Lax state cookie ride along on the callback for both mock and real providers alike, avoiding popup/postMessage complexity.

nodes.label: One-way Arabic/RTL flip approach (superseded)
nodes.rationale: Original scope assumed a permanent one-way flip of the admin to Arabic/RTL with hardcoded Arabic strings and no toggle; superseded when scope changed to a runtime EN/AR + LTR/RTL toggle, split into 004/005/006.

nodes.label: No-FOUC theme mitigation strategy
nodes.rationale: First paint before theme-detection runs must not flash the wrong theme; mitigated via an inline blocking script in <head> that sets the class before paint, or suppressHydrationWarning plus an early effect.

nodes.label: Stable-hash entity badge color rotation
nodes.rationale: A fixed 5-color rotation (brand-500/gold-500/blue-500/green-500/pink-500) assigned by stable hash of an entity's id/name so a given product/category always gets the same color across renders, making list widgets instantly scannable by color.
